data.name: Sympathetic Rage
data.description: When an ally within 30 feet is raging, you can spend 5 stamina points to enter a sympathetic rage even if you aren't adjacent to that ally. Until the rage ends, you only need to stay within 30 feet of a raging ally to maintain your sympathetic rage.
